lines.text: The destroyer will be destroyed, and the nations scatter when the LORD rises.
The LORD fills Zion with justice and righteousness, and the fear of the LORD is its treasure.
The treaty is broken, and Sharon is like a desert while Bashan and Carmel shake off their blossoms.
The one who walks righteously will have the mountain fortress as his refuge, and his eyes will see the priest in his robes.
The LORD is their Judge, lawgiver and King, and the people who dwell in Zion will be forgiven of iniquity.
